The framework's `Concept` (`openmrs-esm-core`, `packages/framework/esm-api/src/types/concept-resource.ts:4`) is imported from `@openmrs/esm-framework` in two places in the patient chart app. Those are the direct consumers that a behaviour change would reach:

1. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts`**: `Concept` is imported on line 2 and used in the `ObsPayload` interface (line 132), which builds the obs sent when posting encounters.
2. **`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/obs-table-horizontal/obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx`**: `Concept` is imported on line 13 and used for the `concepts` prop (lines 274 and 381) of the horizontal obs table.

Several other chart files also have a `Concept` name, but they declare their own local type rather than using the framework's, so a framework change would not reach them directly:
- `esm-patient-tests-app/src/types.ts`, `esm-patient-notes-app/src/types/index.ts`, `esm-form-entry-app/src/app/types/index.ts`, `esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/types/order.ts`, and `esm-patient-chart-app/.../useVisitAttributeType.tsx`.
- `esm-patient-tests-app`'s `helper.tsx` and `usePanelData.tsx` import their `Concept` from the local tests-app types, not from the framework.

Not enumerated: framework types such as `Obs` and `Order` have `concept` fields typed as `Concept`. Any chart code that reads those fields could also be affected, but I did not trace each one.
